short_description: Keep home maintenance, repairs, appliance details and expenses together. Private local records, no mandatory account.
long_description:
Plan household maintenance, keep repair records and save appliance information in one place. Fixavora stores your home records on your device and works without an account. Add rooms, recurring tasks, warranty dates, contractor details and document links.

The free tier includes one active property, up to 15 active maintenance tasks and basic repair and appliance records. Premium is an optional one-time Amazon purchase for more properties, warranties, contractors, expense analysis, report exports and encrypted record backups.

The local assistant prepares task drafts for you to review before saving. Voice input and spoken feedback depend on the installed speech engines and language support; typing remains available. Reminders may be delayed by device settings. External document providers may require a connection. Fixavora is an organization tool, not a safety inspection or repair advice service. Current draft builds do not enable purchases; configure and test Amazon IAP before publication.
